description: React component for a system users date range selection menu in Mattermost admin console, including date calculations and menu rendering.

methods.name: get30DaysBack
methods.description: Calculates the date 30 days before the given date.

methods.name: get6MonthsBack
methods.description: Calculates the date 6 months before the given date.

methods.name: getBeginningOfLastMonth
methods.description: Calculates the first day of the previous month.

methods.name: getEndOfLastMonth
methods.description: Calculates the last day of the previous month.

methods.name: SystemUsersDateRangeMenu
methods.description: React functional component rendering a date range selection menu for system users.

methods.name: getSelectedDateRange
methods.description: Returns the localized label for the current date range.

methods.description: Dispatches an action to update the selected date range.
